title: Why teens SHOULDN'T dirty bulk
summary: NH warns teens against dirty bulking: bodyweight-driven strength gains mask fat gain, it can trigger eating disorders and leave stubborn fat, and teens have years to slow bulk. He regrets his own dirty bulk.
claims: Teens shouldn't cut, but dirty bulking is the opposite extreme and fails the goal of looking better
Novice strength programs push fast progress and plate standards, which drives teens to bulk for leverage instead of muscle
Bulking adds mass that moves weight, so you get stronger even without muscle, and what muscle you gain hides under fat
Extreme overfeeding can trigger eating disorders just as crash diets can trigger anorexia
Strength gains during a dirty bulk stop being a reliable indicator of muscle gain
Teens have all the time in the world; they can slow bulk for potentially 10 years with no setbacks
He grew slowly as a teen only because he couldn't afford more food; once free he dirty bulked, got fat, made no progress and regrets it
After his dirty bulk some fat stayed stubborn, especially in his love handles
Big naturals having done a big bulk only shows they were impatient, not that the bulk built the gains
A disciplined slow bulk with strict training would beat dirty bulking
Older lifters have a duty to guide the new generation away from their mistakes
Lifters with body image issues can tolerate a bit more fat, but no-limit bulking just turns into a different self-hatred
